lead: A parish more than a thousand years old on the slopes of Collserola, with plenty of greenery and low density.
text: It was one of the first parishes on the Barcelona plain, with an endowment deed dated 4 July 931, and from 1359 it belonged to the monastery of la Vall d'Hebron. It is a small, residential neighbourhood on the slopes of the Collserola range. The name Agudells already appears in documents from the 10th century, and the 931 deed records 55 households. The Pla de Barris 2025-2028 includes it among the mountain neighbourhoods, with work on public space and accessibility.

With 7,890 inhabitants in 1.68 km², it has a density of 4,694 inhabitants/km², very low for Barcelona, large green spaces and good public transport links. At 2,456 €/m², it has the lowest average sale price in Horta-Guinardó. If you are selling, the average sale price is 29% below the Horta-Guinardó average. Within the neighbourhood, the price of each flat depends on its condition, its floor and its building, so it is best to compare it with nearby sales rather than with the district average. If you are buying, an 80 m² flat costs about 196,000 € on average, and this is one of the most affordable neighbourhoods in Horta-Guinardó (11th of 11 by price). If you are investing, the average rent (831 €/month) is 9% below the district; before deciding, it is worth studying each deal with real figures for purchase, renovation and rental income.
housing: Residential blocks and houses on the hillside, with plenty of greenery around.
places: Església de Sant Genís dels Agudells
